submissions.title: Cold Light, Slow Weather
submissions.tagline: Photographs of cold light, slow weather, and the people who wait for it.
techniques: Hand-authored SVG scenes: layered linear/radial gradients, procedurally walked geometry, seeded per-instance randomness (Basalt Dawn, The Quiet Hour, Neon Tram, Fractured Light, Salt Flats Mirror, Rain on Line 9, Chromatic Drift, Glacier Blue, Crosswalk Ballet)

SVG filter primitives for texture and optics: feTurbulence fractal-noise film grain everywhere, feDisplacementMap refraction in Fractured Light, Chromatic Drift, Ink in Water and Salt Flats Mirror, plus blur-based bloom and glow
Canvas 2D generative portrait (Vera): gaussian height-field face, Lambert-shaded per-pixel skin pass, hatched stroke field, canvas blur silhouette - rendered once and exported as a data URL
CSS-only still life (Hands of the Baker): stacked radial gradients, blur(), inset box-shadows and mix-blend-mode with an animated flour drift
Live canvas sky behind #hero: additive radial gradients, pointer parallax and an IntersectionObserver-gated requestAnimationFrame loop
Inline SVG fractal-noise data URI used as an animated film-grain layer across the whole page
